H5711H.name: Adah
H5711H.desc: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
H5711H.brief: Hittite wife of Esau; mother of Eliphaz
H5711H.short: Adah, also known as Basemath, was one of Esau's Hittite wives and the mother of Eliphaz, who became a chief in the land of Edom.

H5711G.name: Adah
H5711G.desc: Woman living at the time before the Flood
H5711G.brief: Wife of Lamech; mother of Jabal and Jubal
H5711G.short: Adah was one of the two wives of Lamech, a descendant of Cain, and the mother of Jabal, the first to live in tents and raise livestock, and Jubal, the first to play the lyre and pipe.

H5718H.name: Adaiah
H5718H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5718H.short: Adaiah, a descendant of Benjamin, is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

H5718I.name: Adaiah
H5718I.desc: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
H5718I.brief: Priest, descendant of Malchijah, during the post-exilic period
H5718I.short: Adaiah, a priest and descendant of Malchijah, served in the house of God during the post-exilic period in Jerusalem.

H5718J.name: Adaiah
H5718J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5718J.brief: Father of Maaseiah, during the reign of Joash
H5718J.short: Adaiah was the father of Maaseiah, one of the captains who supported Jehoiada the priest in overthrowing Athaliah and installing Joash as king of Judah.

H5718G.name: Adaiah
H5718G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5718G.brief: Father of Jedidah who was mother of King Josiah of Judah
H5718G.short: Adaiah of Bozkath's daughter Jedidah was the mother of King Josiah, who reigned over Judah and initiated significant religious reforms.

H5718K.name: Adaiah
H5718K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5718K.brief: A leader who married a foreign wife
H5718K.short: Adaiah, one of the descendants of Bani, was among the men who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra.

H5718L.name: Adaiah
H5718L.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5718L.brief: A priest who married a foreign wife
H5718L.short: Adaiah, one of the descendants of Harim, was a priest who had married a foreign woman during the time of Ezra.

H5718M.name: Adaiah
H5718M.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5718M.brief: An ancestor of Maaseiah, a resident of Jerusalem
H5718M.short: Adaiah was an ancestor of Maaseiah, a leader who resided in Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

H5717I.name: Adiel
H5717I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5717I.short: Adiel, the son of Azmaveth, was one of the officials in charge of King David's treasuries.

H5717G.name: Adiel
H5717G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5717G.brief: Simeonite leader during the reign of Hezekiah
H5717G.short: Adiel was one of the Simeonite leaders who, during the reign of King Hezekiah, attacked the Hamites and Meunites in the valley of Gedor and settled in their lands.

H5717H.name: Adiel
H5717H.desc: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
H5717H.brief: A priest in Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time
H5717H.short: Adiel (also called Azarel) was a priest who served in Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

H5720G.name: Adin
H5720G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5720G.brief: Jewish exile who returned to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel
H5720G.short: Adin was one of the Jewish exiles who returned to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel after the Babylonian captivity, as recorded in the lists of returnees in Ezra and Nehemiah.

H5720H.name: Adin
H5720H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5720H.brief: Jewish leader who signed Nehemiah's covenant
H5720H.short: Adin was one of the leaders of the people who signed the covenant of faithfulness to God during the time of Nehemiah.

H5721.name: Adina
H5721.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5721.brief: One of David's mighty men, a Reubenite leader
H5721.short: Adina, the son of Shiza the Reubenite, was one of David's mighty men and a leader among the Reubenites.

H5722.name: Adino
H5722.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H5722.brief: Alternate name or description of Josheb-Basshebeth
H5722.short: Adino the Eznite is mentioned in some translations of <ref="2Sa.23.8">2Sa.23.8</ref>) as one of David's mighty men, but the Hebrew text is unclear, and it may be a description of Josheb-Basshebeth's actions rather than a separate person.

H5724.name: Adlai
H5724.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5724.brief: Overseer of King David's herds in the valleys
H5724.short: Adlai was responsible for overseeing King David's herds that were pastured in the valleys.

H5733G.name: Adna
H5733G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5733G.brief: Israelite who married a foreign woman during the exile
H5733G.short: Adna was one of the Israelites who had married foreign women during the Babylonian exile and pledged to put away his foreign wife as part of Ezra's reforms.

H5733H.name: Adna
H5733H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5733H.brief: Priest during the high priesthood of Joiakim
H5733H.short: Adna was a priest who served during the time of Joiakim, the son of Jeshua, the high priest who returned from the Babylonian exile.

H5734G.name: Adnah
H5734G.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5734G.brief: Manassite leader who joined David at Ziklag
H5734G.short: Adnah was one of the Manassite leaders who defected to David at Ziklag while he was hiding from Saul.

H5734H.name: Adnah
H5734H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5734H.brief: Commander of 300,000 troops under King Jehoshaphat
H5734H.short: Adnah was a commander from Judah who led 300,000 mighty men of valor in King Jehoshaphat's army.

H5741.name: Adriel
H5741.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H5741.short: Adriel married Saul's daughter Merab and had five sons.

H5761G.name: Avvim
H5761G.desc: People who lived in modern Gaza
H5761G.brief: Ancient people who inhabited the Gaza area
H5761G.short: The Avvim were an ancient people who inhabited the Gaza area before being destroyed by the Caphtorim (<ref="Deut 2:23; Josh 13:3">Deut 2:23; Josh 13:3</ref>).

H5731A.name: Eden
H5731A.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5731A.brief: Levite who assisted in Hezekiah's temple cleansing
H5731A.short: Eden, a Levite from the family of Joah, assisted in the cleansing of the temple during Hezekiah's reign.

H5731G.name: Eden
H5731G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5731G.brief: Levite appointed by Hezekiah to distribute offerings
H5731G.short: Eden, along with other Levites, was appointed by Hezekiah to distribute the contributions, tithes, and dedicated gifts to his brethren in their cities.

H5740A.name: Eder
H5740A.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5740A.brief: Levite descendant of Merari during David's reign
H5740A.short: Eder was a Levite of the family of Merari who served during the reign of King David.

H5738.name: Eder
H5738.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5738.brief: Descendant of Benjamin, son of Beriah
H5738.short: Eder was a descendant of Benjamin, mentioned as one of the sons of Beriah in the genealogy of the Benjamites.

H5700H.name: Eglon
H5700H.brief: King of Moab who oppressed Israel
H5700H.short: Eglon, king of Moab, oppressed Israel for 18 years until Ehud, a left-handed Benjamite, assassinated him and delivered Israel.

H5778.name: Ephai
H5778.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5778.brief: A Netophathite whose son joined Gedaliah.
H5778.short: Ephai the Netophathite was the father of one of the men who came to Gedaliah at Mizpah.

H5714H.name: Iddo
H5714H.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5714H.brief: A Levite in the genealogy of temple singers
H5714H.short: Iddo (or Adaiah), a Levite in the genealogy of the temple singers.

H5714G.name: Iddo
H5714G.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H5714G.brief: Abinadab's son, an official under King Solomon
H5714G.short: Iddo, the son of Abinadab, was an official in Mahanaim during King Solomon's reign.

H5714I.name: Iddo
H5714I.desc: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5714I.brief: A seer and prophet during the divided monarchy
H5714I.short: Iddo, a seer and prophet who recorded the events of the reigns of Solomon, Rehoboam, and Abijah.

H5714J.name: Iddo
H5714J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5714J.brief: Zechariah's grandfather, a priest and prophet in post-exilic Judah
H5714J.short: Iddo, the grandfather of the prophet Zechariah, was a priest and prophet in post-exilic Judah.

H5714K.name: Iddo
H5714K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5714K.brief: A priest during the time of Zerubbabel.
H5714K.short: Iddo, also known as Adaia, was a priest who returned to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel and was head of a priestly family during the time of Joiakim.

H5745.name: Obal
H5745.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H5745.short: Obal was one of the sons of Joktan, a descendant of Shem, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

H5744I.name: Obed
H5744I.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5744I.short: Obed was an Ishmaelite warrior who fought in David's army.

H5744H.name: Obed
H5744H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5744H.short: Obed was a descendant of Judah through the line of Jerahmeel.

H5744J.name: Obed
H5744J.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5744J.short: Obed was a gatekeeper in the temple, the son of Shemaiah.

H5744K.name: Obed
H5744K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5744K.short: Obed was the father of Azariah, one of the captains who supported Joash in overthrowing Athaliah.

H5744G.name: Obed
H5744G.short: Obed was the son of Boaz and Ruth, and the grandfather of King David.

H5752G.name: Oded
H5752G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5752G.short: Oded was a prophet and the father of Azariah, who prophesied during the reign of King Asa of Judah.

H5752H.name: Oded
H5752H.desc: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5752H.brief: Prophet who confronted victorious Israelite army
H5752H.short: Oded was a prophet who confronted the Israelite army returning from a victory over Judah, urging them to release their Judean captives.

H5747.name: Og
H5747.desc: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5747.brief: King of Bashan, defeated by Israel
H5747.short: Og was the Amorite king of Bashan who was defeated by the Israelites during their journey to the Promised Land.

H5793G.name: Uthai
H5793G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5793G.brief: Judahite who resettled in Jerusalem after the exile
H5793G.short: Uthai, a descendant of Perez, resettled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H5793H.name: Uthai
H5793H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5793H.brief: Exile who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra
H5793H.short: Uthai, along with Zabbud, led a group returning to Jerusalem with Ezra.

H5780G.name: Uz
H5780G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H5780G.brief: Son of Aram, grandson of Shem
H5780G.short: Uz, son of Aram and grandson of Shem, was an early Semitic patriarch.

H5780H.name: Uz
H5780H.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H5780H.short: Uz, son of Nahor and nephew of Abraham, was an Aramean.

H5780I.name: Uz
H5780I.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H5780I.brief: Son of Dishan, a Horite chief
H5780I.short: Uz, a Horite, was the son of Dishan, a chief in Seir.

H5798H.name: Uzza
H5798H.short: Uzza was a Benjamite born in Moab during the exile.

H5798I.name: Uzza
H5798I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5798I.brief: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from Babylon
H5798I.short: Uzza was an ancestor of temple servants who returned from Babylonian exile.

H5798B.name: Uzzah
H5798B.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5798B.brief: Levite of the clan of Merari
H5798B.short: Uzzah, a Levite of the Merarite clan, was the son of Shimei.

H5798A.name: Uzzah
H5798A.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H5798A.brief: Died while moving the ark; place named after him
H5798A.short: Uzzah died while moving the ark; the place was named Perez-uzzah.

H5735.name: Adadah
H5735.brief: A town in the Negev region of Judah.
H5735.short: Adadah, a town in the southernmost part of Judah.

H5723.name: Adithaim
H5723.brief: A town in the Shephelah region of Judah.
H5723.short: Adithaim, a town allotted to Judah in the Shephelah.

H5725.name: Adullam
H5725.brief: A Canaanite city, later fortified by Judah.
H5725.short: Adullam, a city in Judah, known for its cave where David hid.

H5762.name: Avith
H5762.brief: Capital city of Edomite king Hadad.
H5762.short: Avith was the capital city of Hadad, an early Edomite king.

H5761H.name: Avvim
H5761H.brief: Town allotted to the tribe of Benjamin.
H5761H.short: Avvim was a town allotted to the tribe of Benjamin. (<ref="Joshua 18:23">Joshua 18:23</ref>)

H5729.name: Eden
H5729.brief: A city or region, possibly in Mesopotamia or Syria.
H5729.short: Eden, a city or region mentioned in the Old Testament, possibly located in Mesopotamia or Syria (<ref="2Ki.19.12; Isaiah 37:12; Ezk.27.23">2Ki.19.12; Isaiah 37:12; Ezk.27.23</ref>).

H5731B.name: Eden
H5731B.brief: The perfect garden where God placed Adam and Eve.
H5731B.short: Eden, the perfect garden created by God, where He placed Adam and Eve (<ref="Genesis 2:8, 10, 15; 3:23-24; 4:16; Isaiah 51:3; Ezk.28.13; 31:9, 16, 18; 36:35; Jol.2.3">Genesis 2:8, 10, 15; 3:23-24; 4:16; Isaiah 51:3; Ezk.28.13; 31:9, 16, 18; 36:35; Jol.2.3</ref>).

H5740B.name: Eder
H5740B.brief: A town in the Negev region of Judah.
H5740B.short: Eder, a town located in the Negev region of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:21">Joshua 15:21</ref>).

H5700G.name: Eglon
H5700G.brief: Amorite king of Lachish; city in Judah
H5700G.short: Eglon, an Amorite king of Lachish defeated by Joshua, also a city in Judah.

H5755.name: Ivvah
H5755.brief: City conquered by Assyria, people resettled in Samaria.
H5755.short: Ivvah (or Avva) was a city conquered by Assyria, whose people were resettled in Samaria. (<ref="2Ki.18.34, 19:13; Isaiah 37:13; 2Ki.17.24, 31">2Ki.18.34, 19:13; Isaiah 37:13; 2Ki.17.24, 31</ref>)

H5780J.name: Uz
H5780J.brief: A region associated with Job, Edom, and Arabia
H5780J.short: Uz, a region mentioned in the Bible as the homeland of Job, possibly located in Edom or Arabia (<ref="Job.1.1; Jer. 25:20; Lam. 4:21">Job.1.1; Jer. 25:20; Lam. 4:21</ref>).

H5799.name: Azazel
H5799.brief: Mysterious figure connected to the Day of Atonement
H5799.short: Azazel, mentioned in Leviticus 16, is a mysterious figure connected to the scapegoat ritual on the Day of Atonement.
